column1: # "wildlife" remix - contains everything from the wildlife mod
# The two mobs in this remix - simple deer and simple wolves - are somewhat simplistic, and are
#   intended (both in the original code, and in unimobs) to be code examples rather than suitable
# As a result, they are not compatible with the Petz API. They cannot be bred, fed or tamed, and
#   they do not have spawn eggs. Instead, the "opt_wildlife" package spawns them in all biomes
